subject: Urgent: admitted to hospital — need to change today's interviews
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview schedule today (Jordan Price)

Hi Ava — I’m really sorry to do this last minute. I was evaluated at urgent care this morning for severe dehydration and the doctor just admitted me for observation. They said I need to stay for at least 24 hours.

I am still very excited about the opportunity with Redwood but I won’t be able to make the three interviews scheduled for today (10:30am, 1:00pm, 3:00pm PT). If it helps the team, I can:
- do a short phone touchpoint later today if I’m released, or
- complete a take-home coding exercise asynchronously if that’s acceptable, or
- reschedule for later this week.

I apologize again — I didn’t expect this. Thank you for understanding.

Best,
Jordan Price
(415) 555-0127
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jordanprice

[No attachments]
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview schedule today (Jordan Price) — options

Jordan — thanks for letting us know and I’m really sorry you’re dealing with that. Health first — please don’t worry about today.

We can do whichever works better for you; two options from our side:
1) Convert the remainder of today’s interviews into an asynchronous take-home + short follow-up call (we’ll extend deadlines and provide clear instructions).
2) Pause and reschedule all sessions for the next available window (we have openings Thursday/Friday this week).

If you’re up for the take-home, I’m attaching the instructions and a calendar block with possible deadlines. No pressure — let me know what you prefer and I’ll coordinate with the interview team.

Attaching: Takehome_Instructions_v2.pdf; Calendar_Block_Options.ics

Rest up and feel better,
Ava
Ava Chen
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (650) 555-0147
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview schedule today (Jordan Price) — quick internal note

Quick note for the panel: I’m OK with the take-home route given the circumstances, but two asks before we move forward:
1) Keep the take-home scope brief (~2–3 hours max) and give Jordan 72 hours to submit. We don’t want to penalize him for being hospitalized.
2) Preserve the on-site focus areas: systems design (45m) + culture/role fit (30m). If he does the take-home, I want the debriefers to use the same rubric.

If Jordan prefers to reschedule, we can move to Thursday 11/25 (I can shift my calendar). I’ll be out Friday morning but can cover afternoon.

Thanks — I’ll defer to you, Ava, for what to offer him.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Search & Runtime
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview schedule today (Jordan Price) — take-home option confirmed

Jordan — thanks for confirming. We’ll go with the take-home to keep things moving but absolutely no rush. Details below: 

- Scope: small systems exercise (approx 2–3 hours) + 4 bullet design notes.
- Deadline: 72 hours from when you’re able to start (we realize hospital stays vary) — if you need more time, tell us and we’ll extend.
- What we’ll do after submission: 30-minute async debrief with a hiring manager or a short phone call if you prefer.

Attached are: Takehome_Instructions_v2.pdf (with prompt and rubric) and Calendar_Block_Options.ics (suggested blocks for a follow-up call).

Next steps for you: reply to this email when you’re ready to receive the prompt (I’ll mark the start time). If you prefer reschedule instead, tell me what days/times work and I’ll coordinate.

Take care — and please let us know if the team can be flexible on timing.

Best,
Ava
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview schedule today (Jordan Price) — take-home option confirmed

Hi Ava — thank you so much for the quick reply and for being flexible. I’m still admitted but I feel a little better; I’d like to accept the take-home option. Please go ahead and send the prompt when you’re ready — I’ll start as soon as I can and will reach out if I need more time.

Appreciate the team’s understanding.

Jordan

[Signed from mobile]
